arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly treated it as a fridge problem; we have corrected it and are treating it as an urgent front door repair. Until it's fixed, please don't slam the door, as the glass could break. Keep clear of the door if you see any cracks. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door close and lock securely at the moment, so the flat is safe overnight? 2) Is there any cracked glass? 3) Does the back door have the same problem? 4) Any access details we should know (entry codes, alarm) and any pets? We aim to get an urgent repair done within 72 hours of approval; we're asking the landlord now and will update you by tomorrow.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly treated it as a fridge problem; we have corrected it and are treating it as an urgent front door repair. Until it's fixed, please don't slam the door, as the glass could break. Keep clear of the door if you see any cracks. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door close and lock securely at the moment, so the flat is safe overnight? 2) Is there any cracked glass? 3) Does the back door have the same problem? 4) Any access details we should know (entry codes, alarm) and any pets? We aim to get an urgent repair done within 72 hours of approval; we're asking the landlord now and will update you by tomorrow.

arguments.decision_needed: Tenant reports front door (and back door) must be slammed to shut; a contractor visiting for another job warned the glass could shatter. Do you want us to send our contractor to inspect and repair, or will you arrange your own? Reply by 2024-06-08.
